categories.main_business_segments: The company specializes in customized memory IC design, focusing on IoT-related memory products (IoTRAM™), AI-related memory products (VHM™), and silicon capacitor products (S-SiCap™). It operates two main business divisions: IoT business providing cost-effective IoTRAM™ products for connectivity, wearable, and other applications; and AI business focusing on high-bandwidth memory solutions for AI and high-performance computing (HPC).
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: Core technologies include 3D heterogeneous wafer-on-wafer (WoW) stacking for VHM™ products, micro-bump bonding for VHMInterposer™, and hybrid bonding for VHMStack™. The company also develops ultra-low-power and ultra-high-bandwidth customized DRAM, pseudo SRAM, and silicon capacitor (S-SiCap™) integrated passive devices. Manufacturing is outsourced to leading wafer foundries and packaging/testing vendors, with the company focusing on IC design and IP licensing.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primary customers are global semiconductor and chip manufacturers requiring customized memory solutions for IoT devices, wearable technology, AI servers, HPC platforms, and edge computing devices. Major end markets include AI data centers, 5G communications, consumer electronics, and industrial IoT applications. The company maintains long-term partnerships with leading global chipmakers.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in Taiwan and China, with significant sales exposure to China (78% of revenue), Taiwan (14%), Americas (4%), and other regions. It also has overseas subsidiaries in the USA, Hong Kong, and China to support local markets and R&D. The company’s global presence includes cooperation with international customers and suppliers.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company is positioned upstream in the semiconductor supply chain as an IC design house specializing in customized memory products. It outsources wafer fabrication, testing, and packaging to foundries and subcontractors, focusing on design, IP development, and customer-specific customization.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include advancing 3D heterogeneous integration memory technologies (VHM™, VHMStack™, VHMInterposer™), ultra-low-power IoT memory, and silicon capacitor IP for high-end mobile and HPC chips. The company invests heavily in R&D to develop new products for AI, edge computing, 5G, and wearable markets, and pursues strategic alliances and investments in power management ICs and RFID technologies.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through sales of customized memory IC chips, licensing of silicon IP, and provision of design services. The company also earns non-recurring engineering (NRE) fees and royalties from IP licensing. Sales are mostly direct to semiconductor manufacturers and system integrators.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes in the customized memory IC design segment, differentiating from large standard DRAM manufacturers like Samsung, Micron, and SK Hynix by focusing on specialized low-power and high-bandwidth memory solutions. It holds a leading position in customized IoT memory and emerging AI memory markets, maintaining strong customer relationships and technological leadership.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In the reported year, the company achieved consolidated revenue of approximately NT$4.19 billion with a slight 1% decline from the prior year but improved gross margin to 51%. Net profit was NT$1.58 billion with EPS of NT$9.73, reflecting solid profitability and a 9% net income growth. The company maintains a strong financial structure with low debt (8% debt ratio) and substantial cash and financial assets, supporting ongoing R&D and strategic investments.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its ability to deliver highly customized, low-power, and high-bandwidth memory solutions tailored to emerging AI, IoT, and HPC applications. Its proprietary 3D stacking and silicon capacitor technologies provide superior performance and energy efficiency. Strong customer collaboration in co-developing product specifications and comprehensive technical support further differentiate its offerings.
